About Daily Love Family Daycare

At Daily Love Family Daycare, every child is welcomed like family. We provide a safe, loving, and educational environment where children can learn, explore, and build confidence every day.

Our Mission

To provide every child with a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment where they feel loved, respected, and encouraged to reach their fullest potential.

Our Vision

To become one of Montgomery County’s most trusted family childcare homes by creating a foundation of love, learning, and lifelong confidence for every child entrusted to our care.

Our Core Values

Love First

Every child deserves kindness, patience, compassion, and respect.

Safety Always

Each child’s health, safety, and well-being are our highest priorities.

Learning Through Play

Children learn best through fun, exploration, creativity, and hands-on activities.

Family Partnership

We believe parents, guardians, and caregivers work best as a team.

Individual Growth

Every child develops differently, and we recognize and celebrate each milestone.

Partner With a Childcare Team That Feels Like Family

We welcome parents and guardians who value nurturing care, communication, and learning through play.
